description: Research a Polymarket bet by pulling the relevant Pipeworx data for it in one call. Pass a market slug ("will-kristi-noem-win-the-2028-republican-presidential-nomination"), a polymarket.com URL, or a question text. A dated slug ("...-by-june-30-2026") still resolves after it settles, the resolver retries a closed-market lookup rather than giving up on the bare one, so either dated or undated works; prefer whichever slug you actually have. The tool resolves the market, classifies the bet, fans ou

depth.description: quick = 2-3 evidence sources, thorough = full fan-out. Default thorough.

include_raw.description: Default false. When false (recommended), FRED/FDA/GDELT/Federal-Register evidence is summarized to the few fields agents actually use, keeps responses under ~20KB. Pass true to get full upstream payloads (50KB-500KB) when you need to recompute deltas, cite specific observations, or post-process.

market.description: Polymarket slug ("will-kristi-noem-win-the-2028-republican-presidential-nomination"), full URL ("https://polymarket.com/event/..."), or question text ("Will Bitcoin hit $150k?"). Dated slugs still resolve after they settle, the resolver retries a closed-market lookup, so either a dated or undated slug works.
